title: cestrum benthamii
intro: Cestrum benthamii, commonly known as the Night-Blooming Jasmine, is a flowering plant in the nightshade family. It has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, particularly in treating anxiety and insomnia, due to its calming effects and sedative properties. The plant's health benefits are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which have been shown to possess anxiolytic, anticonvulsant, and antioxidant properties. Additionally, the therapeutic actions of Cestrum benthamii include promoting relaxation, reducing stress, and improving sleep quality.
